title: Latte Art Rose: Level 1 VS Level 99 #shorts #latteart #tutorial
description:
Latte Art Rose: Level 1 VS Level 99

Level 1
The design is not filling the cup, looks not complete. The base is not wrapped all the way to the top, and there are too much spacing across the design, making the design looks hollow, feels like not completed. Mostly caused by not thinking through the design before pouring.

Level 99
Think and maybe draw before pouring the design, how the spacing should be, how to fill up the cup with the design. The design looks more completed, filling the whole cup.

Like, subscribe, and share to your coffee and latte art buddies.
